edges: Jacob Armitage hides Edward and his siblings in his cottage and disguises them as his grandchildren.
Edward and Humphrey develop and expand the farmstead after Jacob Armitage's death.
Edward and his siblings rescue Pablo from a pitfall trap.
Edward encounters Heatherstone, who is in charge of the Royal land in the New Forest.
Edward rescues Patience from a house-fire.
Edward works as a secretary for Heatherstone while pretending to be Jacob Armitage's grandson.
Edward joins the army of the future King Charles II.
Edward learns that Patience loves him and accepts his declarations of love.
Edward works as a mercenary soldier in exile until the Restoration when he and Patience are reunited.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Florentina vows to take charge of Marianela and have her live with her like a sister.
Marianela attempts suicide but is saved by Teodoro Golfin.
Teodoro and Florentina take care of Marianela while she is hiding from Pablo.
Heatherstone has been awarded the old Arnwood estate.

edges: After the Royalist defeat at the Battle of Worcester, Edward returns to the New Forest.
